reason: The monoclinic cell (about 7.896 x 5.728 x 5.502 A, beta about 90.237 degrees), Z=2, and a chemically plausible ordered double-perovskite framework are well supported, and the attempt reports a good internal whole-profile Rwp of about 4.2-4.6%. Exact recovery is not sufficiently established, however: no comparable whole-pattern score was supplied; the submitted CIF formally declares P1 although the narrative relies on detected Pc/Pn symmetry; and refinement was confined to one hand-built Pc/Pn framework. The four tested assignment labels refined to symmetry/origin-equivalent descriptions, so they did not test materially distinct A-site ordering topologies, parent or lower-symmetry models, disorder/antisite possibilities, or independent coordinate solutions. Thus the fit supports the cell and average framework more strongly than the exact symmetry, coordinates, occupancies, and Ca/Sm-Mg/Nb ordering, and another attempt should instantiate and compare those scientifically plausible alternatives.
